investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser/JS execution) against the venue's own official '/en/event/' events archive page (verified directly, not the '/practical-information' history page a prior pass mistakenly checked). The static HTML itself carries the venue's own full events archive as repeated 'bloc_extrait evenement' cards, each with a complete day-name + day + month-name + FULL YEAR date string directly on the card — no escalation needed.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://www.letrianon.fr/en/event/ returned this venue's own WordPress custom-post-type 'evenement' archive page (body class 'post-type-archive-evenement'), containing 35 static 'bloc_extrait evenement' event cards (33 cleanly parsed by this investigation's own extraction regex — 2 titles contain characters the bounded sampling regex did not match, not a data-availability gap), each stating its own title, WordPress post ID (data-id), first-party detail-page URL, and a complete 'Weekday DD Month YYYY' date string (e.g. 'Sunday 30 August 2026') directly on the card. This fully answered the investigation question at Level 1; no escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Le Trianon (concert hall, 80 Boulevard Rochechouart, 75018 Paris; co-managed with Élysée Montmartre)

identity.notes: The retained page's own <title> reads 'Events - Trianon' at the venue's own domain letrianon.fr. The same retained page's own footer directly states the venue's own address: '80 BD DE ROCHECHOUART' / '75018 PARIS' — matching the assigned venue address exactly.

site_classification.platform: WordPress, custom post type 'evenement' (theme 'vkd_tem', child theme 'vkdchild_trianon'), post-type-archive page. Every event is fully represented as a static, repeated HTML card on the archive page itself — no client-side rendering or AJAX pagination was needed to see the full listing. Ticket purchase happens on a first-party 'billetterie'-less flow that redirects to the third-party 'Hubber' checkout domain (trianon8-prod.mutu.hubber.fr), confirmed only on a per-event detail page, never used as this collector's data path.

title.notes: Each card's own 'title' attribute (and identically its own '.titre' div text), stated directly.

start_date.notes: Each card's own '.date' div directly states a complete day-name + day + month-name + FULL YEAR string (e.g. 'Sunday 30 August 2026') — a single piece of retained evidence already carrying the complete date, mechanically parsed (not combined from a separate page/section heading), so recorded as DIRECT_SOURCE rather than DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT.

time.notes: Not present on the list/archive card itself. Confirmed present on this source's own per-event detail page (e.g. https://www.letrianon.fr/en/event/eartheater/ states '2026 August 30, Sunday at 20h00' plus an informal door-time note '18h30 – Ouverture des portes' in free text) — genuinely resolvable, but only via an additional per-event fetch this investigation's recommended list-only collector does not perform. Left honestly PARTIAL rather than fabricated or silently fetched beyond the confirmed data path.

end.notes: No end-time or end-date is stated anywhere on either the list card or the sampled detail page.

venue_location.notes: Single-venue source. The retained page's own footer directly states the full address.

source_record_id.notes: Each card's own root element carries 'data-id="13452"' — this theme's own WordPress post ID, a standard structural convention of the CMS itself (not this investigation's invention), directly exposed on every card.

event_url.notes: Each card's own anchor 'href', stated directly — this venue's own first-party detail page.

price.notes: No price is shown on the list card or the sampled detail page. Ticket purchase redirects to the third-party Hubber checkout domain (trianon8-prod.mutu.hubber.fr), which this policy does not treat as first-party price authority.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from a self-consistent retained artifact (page title, footer address matching the assigned venue address exactly).
